inlines.v: REL'EVANT, adjective [Latin relever, to relieve, to advance, to raise; re and lever, to raise.] 1. Relieving; lending aid or support. 2. Pertinent; applicable. The testimony is not relevant to the case. The argument is not relevant to the question. [This is the sense in which the word is now generally used.] 3. Sufficient to support the cause.
